#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

bool solve(long long w, long long m);

bool trySolve(long long w, long long m) {
    return m % w == 0 && solve(w, m / w);
}

bool solve(long long w, long long m) {
    if (w <= 3) {
        return true;
    }
    if (m == 1) {
        return true;
    }
    if (trySolve(w, m - 1)) {
        return true;
    }
    if (trySolve(w, m)) {
        return true;
    }
    return trySolve(w, m + 1);
}

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (solve(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
